newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: S.Korean, China ministers meet for defector talks.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean, China ministers meet for defector talks.

text.p: South Korean Foreign Minister Yoo Chong-ha and Chinese counterpart Qian Qichen began talks on Friday on a diplomatic crisis over a North Korean defector, officials said.

The two men were scheduled to meet for 30 minutes to discuss a South Korean appeal for safe passage from Beijing to Seoul for the defector, Hwang Jang-yop, a senior aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-il.

South Korea announced on Wednesday that Hwang had defected in Beijing, and was in Seoul's embassy there. That put China in a diplomatic quandary involving North Korea, its old communist comrade, and South Korea, a new commercial ally and major source of investment.
Pyongyang has charged that Hwang, one of 11 secretaries on the powerful secretariat of North Korea's ruling Workers' Party, had been kidnapped by the South. Seoul has denied the charge.

Yoo and Qian met on the sidelines of a conference of Asian and European foreign ministers which the South Korean had decided to miss because of the defection crisis, but then went ahead with the trip to Singapore to meet his Chinese counterpart.
